title: 군무원 특별채용 등에 관한 특례규정 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1

Article 2 (Persons Eligible for Special Recruitment)
(1) "Civilian military employees who perform or have performed duties related to defense acquisition projects" in Article 14 (1) of the Addenda to the Defense Acquisition Program Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") means persons who, as of July 22, 2005, belonged to relevant departments of the Army, Navy, or Air Force or the Procurement Headquarters of the Ministry of National Defense performing affairs concerning defense capability improvement projects, procurement of military supplies, and fostering of the defense industry whose functions were transferred to the Defense Acquisition Program Administration under Article 33 (5) of the Government Organization Act, and who are serving as civilian military employees when this Decree enters into force.
(2) Civilian military employees who may be specially recruited as public officials of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration under Article 14 (1) of the Act shall be persons who have at least six months of service or research experience corresponding to the grade to which they are expected to be appointed.
